Name: Wizard's Whimsical Furniture
Author: BackedPotatoes
Description:
This is a furniture mod that replaces Wizard's furniture with a more whimsical alternative. I love the Wizard and his new catalogue, but I've always felt like it lacked a bit of a more magical look, so I made this mod :) You don't need Alternative Textures or any other mod for it to work besides Content Patcher.


[size=5][center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/W30yLxgH/gif-with-no-background.gif[/img][/center][/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/l20T8HY.png[/img]﻿

[b]1.[/b] Download this mod.
[b]2.[/b] Drop the folder inside your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.
Done! You can now play with the new furniture :D


[img]https://i.imgur.com/OFaayk6.png[/img][b]
[/b]
[list]
[*]I would like to make a Bogs compatible palette, but for that first I will need her permission. I don't have plans to add anything else, but I'm always open to feedback. If you have any suggestions, I would love to know <3
[*]There's [b]no combability issues[/b] except for other mods that also change the Wizard's furniture texture. 
[/list]

Now I finally did :D sorry for the few people who have been asking me about this mod! Hope you enjoy it ^^
